text:
alice_sales: Heads up — presales Q from GovBank. They need Canada-only for the POC: inference + logs must remain in CA unless an explicit failover. BYOK with HSM (customer-managed keys), and zero egress to EU. Also want full sub-processor inventory that could touch metadata. Pricing question: dedicated vs private delta and any HSM add-on. Timeline for certs/peering? @ben_sre @claire_security @sam_legal

ben_sre: TL;DR: Hosted API can't guarantee CA-only (control plane signals may cross regions). Dedicated or Private can meet CA-only data path with tenant pinning and routing policy. Failover to us-east-1 OK; we can explicitly exclude EU regions. HSM/BYOK supported in Private, and in Dedicated via customer HSM/partner HSM options. Pricing note: expect ~20-40% premium vs hosted depending on commit and HSM.

ben_sre: Example routing policy we use (informal):
```
{
  "tenant_pin": "ca-central-1",
  "allowed_regions": ["ca-central-1","us-east-1"],
  "deny_regions": ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"],
  "failover_order": ["us-east-1"]
}
```

claire_security: We can provide the subprocessor inventory filtered by region and function. For BYOK/HSM: we'll need a controls review + KMS attestation. HSM in-customer-tenant (Private) is fastest to meet compliance; for Dedicated we do a managed-HSM option that still meets many regs. Timeline estimate: 2–4 weeks for attestation + key onboarding. Need to confirm log retention & whether they want syslogs forwarded to their SIEM.

sam_legal: For the subprocessor list we require an NDA before sharing the detailed mapping. High-level cloud provider/subproc names we can share now. Also: "no egress to EU" on control plane is an exception we can sign but it requires clarifying what signals (metrics/traces/health pings) are allowed. Please get their legal contact.

ops_oncall: For peering we need their target CIDRs, ASNs if using private interconnect, and cert SANs. We rotate control-plane certs every 90 days by default; if they need pinning, that becomes a special ops runbook. Also note: network egress charges for cross-region failover apply.

ben_sre: Pricing roughs (ballpark): HSM add-on ~"$4k/mo" per active HSM in a region, dedicated reserved capacity depends on GPU profile — estimate a mid-tier Dedicated for POC ~"$18k–25k/mo" + HSM + networking. One-time peering setup fee ~"$2k". I will follow up with a formal quote.

claire_security: :eyes: I'll produce the CA-focused subproc list and mark any EU-facing services. Also preparing the security questionnaire partial answers for them to review.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INFR-9245 -> dedicated-tenant-provision, linked to presales/poc-workflow.

alice_sales: Great, thanks team. I'll send NDA and their security questionnaire. Please DM the formal pricing so I can include in the SOW. :thumbsup:
